methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Airtable in the browser. An Airtable account; enterprise administrators may need to allowlist the client.
methods.label: Sign in with Airtable
warnings: An Airtable account; enterprise administrators may need to allowlist the client.

methods.whenToUse: Use a personal access token when browser sign-in is not suitable.
methods.guidanceMd: Create an Airtable personal access token with the scopes and base resources required for the actions you intend to allow. MCP calls inherit your Airtable role and base permissions; organization allowlisting may still apply.
methods.label: Use a personal access token

credentialFields.label: Airtable personal access token
credentialFields.helperMd: Choose provider scopes and resource bases for intended actions; token and user/base role permissions both restrict access.

warnings: Use a disposable or development base for initial write qualification. Enterprise admins may need to allowlist MCP access.
